summary: Everspin Technologies filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement—a $40 million IDIQ subcontract with Amentum Services for Toggle MRAM RDT&E under a U.S. Navy prime contract. The agreement involves milestone payments over 30 months, covers process technology and IP transfer, and includes termination-for-convenience provisions. This is a government research and development contract with no change of control, shareholder vote, or special-situation event. Routine current report—no special situation.
